dogecoin.text: @dogecoin_empire I have neither, but the answer is your partner. It is to set the example for the kids. Biblically, it is the same answer. You leave your parents to become one flesh with your spouse.
@dogecoin_empire I don't drink at all, anyway. As for sex, I'm always at work. I don't have time for that.
@dogecoin_empire A woman who claims they have a high sex drive are also the ones who say they have a headache or they are tired.

@dogecoin_empire For men, hit the gym, read books, learn, and go enjoy nature. For women, stop thinking the world revolves around them, and they wouldn't have ditched their significant other, and spend time in nature.
@dogecoin_empire I thought so, and it apparently isn't for everyone. If it weeds people out, then it makes my life easier.

@dogecoin_empire Went to a walk along a river feeding ducks, and I got complaints that it was too hot and it was too far of a walk, even though we only went about a mile. Fitness and health are important.
